let reindex_and_relocate db ~doc_id ~(contents : DB.doc_contents) :
    doc_meta * anchor list =
  DB.Shingles.delete_doc db doc_id;
  DB.Documents_fuzzy.index db ~doc_id ~contents ~force:false;
  (match contents with
  | DB.Active c -> Anchor.index_shingles db ~doc_id c
  | DB.Deleted -> ());
  let doc_meta =
    match DB.Documents.get_by_id db doc_id with
    | Some m -> m
    | None -> failwith "internal error: just-registered document not found"
  in
  let changed =
    Anchor.relocate_stale_anchors db ~doc_id ~doc_revision:doc_meta.revision
  in
  (doc_meta, changed)

let add_file db (src_doc : App_types.Src_doc.t)
    (text_source : Util.Text_source.t) : doc_meta * anchor list =
  let source_doc = App_types.Src_doc.to_source_doc src_doc in
  Sqlite_util.Connect.with_transaction db (fun () ->
      ensure_source_declared db source_doc.source;
      let doc_id =
        DB.Documents.create_or_update db ~source:source_doc.source
          ~locator:source_doc.locator
          ~contents:(DB.Active text_source.contents)
      in
      DB.Containers.index db ~doc_id src_doc;
      reindex_and_relocate db ~doc_id
        ~contents:(DB.Active text_source.contents))

let remove_document ?(strict = false) db (doc_ref : doc_ref) : anchor list =
  let doc_meta =
    match doc_ref with
    | By_locator src_doc ->
        let source_doc = App_types.Src_doc.to_source_doc src_doc in
        DB.Documents.get_by_locator db ~source:source_doc.source
          source_doc.locator
    | By_id doc_id -> DB.Documents.get_by_id db doc_id
  in
  match doc_meta with
  | None ->
      if strict then
        let ref_str =
          match doc_ref with
          | By_locator src_doc -> App_types.Src_doc.show src_doc
          | By_id doc_id -> App_types.Doc_id.to_string doc_id
        in
        ksprintf failwith "Not indexed: %s" ref_str
      else []
  | Some (meta : T.doc_meta) ->
      Sqlite_util.Connect.with_transaction db (fun () ->
          let doc_id =
            DB.Documents.create_or_update db ~source:meta.source_doc.source
              ~locator:meta.source_doc.locator ~contents:DB.Deleted
          in
          DB.Containers.delete_for_doc db doc_id;
          snd (reindex_and_relocate db ~doc_id ~contents:DB.Deleted))

let align_normalized query target =
  let rec align offset target =
    match Util.Smith_waterman.align Util.Smith_waterman.code query target with
    | None -> None
    | Some aligned ->
        let start, end_ =
          Util.Text.safe_range target ~start:aligned.target.start
            ~end_:aligned.target.end_
        in
        if start = aligned.target.start && end_ = aligned.target.end_ then
          Some
            {
              aligned with
              target = { start = offset + start; end_ = offset + end_ };
            }
        else if start >= end_ then None
        else align (offset + start) (String.sub target start (end_ - start))
  in
  align 0 target

  let selected =
    List.filter
      (fun hit ->
        abs (hit.query_start - hit.doc_start - mode_offset)
        <= match_offset_tolerance)
      hits
  in
  let start, end_ =
    List.fold_left
      (fun (start, end_) hit ->
        (min start hit.doc_start, max end_ hit.doc_end))
      (String.length contents, 0)
      selected
  in

  let end_ =
    max end_
      (min (String.length contents) (String.length query - mode_offset))
  in
  let window =
    {
      T.start = max 0 (start - shingle_length);
      end_ = min (String.length contents) (end_ + shingle_length);
    }
  in
  let start, end_ =
    Util.Text.safe_range contents ~start:window.start ~end_:window.end_
  in
  let window = { T.start; end_ } in
                                                                          
                                                                                
  let maximum_window =
    String.length query + (2 * match_offset_tolerance) + (2 * shingle_length)
  in
  if window.end_ - window.start > maximum_window then None
  else begin
    let target =
      normalize_whitespace
        (String.sub contents window.start (window.end_ - window.start))
    in
    match align_normalized normalized_query target.text with
    | None -> None
    | Some aligned ->
        let start, end_ =
          Util.Text.raw_range_of_normalized target ~start:aligned.target.start
            ~end_:aligned.target.end_

        let start = window.start + start in
        let end_ = window.start + end_ in

        if aligned.identical_bytes < minimum_length then None

  let query_shingles, by_doc = collect_hits db anchor_norm in
                                                                         
  let minimum_hits =
    max 1 ((query_shingles + (2 * shingle_offset) - 1) / (2 * shingle_offset))
  in
  let rejected = ref 0 in
  let candidates =
    Hashtbl.fold
      (fun doc_id hits acc ->
        if List.length hits < minimum_hits then (
          incr rejected;
          acc)
        else
          match DB.Documents.get_full_by_id db doc_id with

                (sprintf "anchor relocation error: missing document in db: %s"
                   (App_types.Doc_id.to_string doc_id))
          | Some (_, DB.Deleted) -> acc
          | Some (meta, DB.Active contents) -> (
              match
                align_candidate ~query ~normalized_query:anchor_norm.text meta
                  contents hits
              with
              | None ->
                  incr rejected;
                  acc
              | Some candidate -> candidate :: acc))
      by_doc []
  in
  ( query_shingles,

let relocate_one db (a : Internal_types.anchor) ~doc_revision =
  let anchor_norm = normalize_whitespace a.raw_contents in
  let query_shingles, minimum_hits, rejected, candidates =
    find_candidates db a.raw_contents anchor_norm
  in
  log_relocation_candidates db a ~doc_revision ~anchor_norm ~query_shingles
    ~minimum_hits ~rejected candidates;
  match candidates with
  | [] ->
      DB.Anchors.mark_attempt_failed db a.anchor_id
        ~doc_revision_attempt:doc_revision;
      None
  | candidate :: _ ->
      let range = candidate.range in
      let raw_contents =
        String.sub candidate.contents range.start (range.end_ - range.start)
      in
      let changed =
        candidate.doc_id <> a.doc_id
        || range <> a.range
        || raw_contents <> a.raw_contents
      in
      let updated =
        {
          a with
          doc_id = candidate.doc_id;
          doc_revision = candidate.revision;
          doc_revision_attempt = candidate.revision;

          last_author = T.Algo;

        "Anchor relocation %s applying relocation: document=%s revision=%d \
         range=B%d-%d changed=%b; previous anchor content still intact"
        (App_types.Anchor_id.to_string a.anchor_id)
        (App_types.Doc_id.to_string candidate.doc_id)
        candidate.revision range.start range.end_ changed;
      DB.Anchors.relocate db updated;
      if changed then Some updated else None

I found four potential issues with anchor relocation:

- **P0 — An intact anchor can move to a duplicate in another file.** Candidates are ranked by text coverage, hit count, then document ID, with no preference for the current document. An unrelated edit elsewhere in the original file can therefore move the anchor to an earlier indexed copy. [Anchor.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-cm+answer/base-libs/text/Anchor.ml:355)

- **P0 — Relocation can cross unrelated sources.** Shingle hits are collected globally without checking the anchor’s source. If the original text is deleted, an identical snippet in another registered source can become its destination. [Anchor.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-cm+answer/base-libs/text/Anchor.ml:206)

- **P0 — Moving documents can suppress a later review alert.** Relocation keeps `acknowledged_revision` while changing `doc_id`. If the old document’s acknowledged revision is higher than the destination’s revision, a later failed relocation can remain `needs_review = false` until the destination passes that old revision number. [Anchor.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-cm+answer/base-libs/text/Anchor.ml:512)

- **P1 — Repeated text can leave an intact anchor outdated.** Indexing drops every occurrence of a repeated shingle. A short anchor made of repeated text may then have no hits to support relocation after an unrelated edit. [Anchor.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-cm+answer/base-libs/text/Anchor.ml:159)
